_design: Vignette rule: rocks never spawn alone. Tighter cluster (minCount stays 2). Added size variants (_sm) at cluster edge for natural falloff. Big boulder at center is the focal point. Used across meadow (rare), forest (rarer), snow (moderate), mountain (heavy via stratification layer). groveCentersPer100 kept low (0.8) — occasional landmark feature, not terrain clutter.

center._: Large boulder at heart; bumped resource yield

placement._: Never alone (minCount). Min spacing 10 = rock outcrops are landmarks, not repeated texture.
